data.value: Provide the original query, of up to 100 thousand characters.

data.value: Nothing to check: provide the rewritten query, the indexes or both.

data.name: Plan.NoLive
data.value: This repository has no live database registered. The user registers the connection on the database screen of Rastro (the registration and the connection string are screen-only); then the estimated plan comes through here. Without the live database, use analyze_query, which reads only the code.

data.name: Plan.Undecipherable
data.value: the MCP server could not open the registered connection (the encryption key belongs to the Rastro API). Ask the user to open Rastro once and register the connection again on the database screen.
